subject: Evidence request: CI runbook + code-review samples for FinServCo SIG
messages:
From: Alicia Park <alicia.park@assessor.example.com>
To: diego.fernandez@redwood.com
Cc: security@finservco.com
Date: Fri, 8 May 2026 16:23:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Secure SDLC artifacts + CI runbook (FinServCo SIG)

Hi Diego,

AssessCorp is scoping the SIG submission for FinServCo and we need a short packet illustrating how Redwood implements key Secure SDLC controls. Specifically, can you provide:

- A copy of the CI/CD runbook or an export of the relevant sections (build auth, ephemeral creds, merge gating).
- A small sample of code-review exports showing sampling methodology (redacted PR ids OK).
- A timeline or changelog showing an example change moving from PR -> deploy (including approvals).

We prefer a single ZIP but separate attachments are fine. Targeting an intake on Monday (May 11) so a quick turnaround would be appreciated.

If you need to route this to a security engineer, please advise who will be the primary contact.

Thanks,
Alicia Park
Senior Assessor, AssessCorp
Alicia.Park@assessor.example.com

---
Note: this request relates to SIG / CAIQ attributes for FinServCo (confidential).

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Park <alicia.park@assessor.example.com>
Cc: irene.choi@redwood.com, jordan.blake@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 9 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Secure SDLC artifacts + CI runbook (FinServCo SIG)

Alicia — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Irene (sec eng) and Jordan (platform) who will assemble the artifacts. Marissa from solutions will hold the intake with FinServCo.

Quick notes on scope and constraints:
- We can share a redacted CI runbook (PDF) that includes pipeline auth, short-lived credential flow, runner isolation, and merge-gate policy.
- For PR exports we will provide a sampled CSV (no full commit content) and a short explanation of sampling methodology.
- Change timeline will be a redacted example (dates relative, no customer secrets).

Attachments I will drop here for initial context: 1) redwood_ci_runbook_v2.pdf (redacted), 2) code_review_sampling_2026-04.csv (sample), 3) change-management-timeline.xlsx

Irene/Jordan — can you confirm the runbook section we should send and whether we need legal to review any additional redactions?

Diego Fernandez
Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0142

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: diego.fernandez@redwood.com
Cc: irene.choi@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 9 May 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Secure SDLC artifacts + CI runbook (FinServCo SIG)

On Sat, May 9, 2026 at 09:12 Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com> wrote:
> Irene/Jordan — can you confirm the runbook section we should send and whether we need legal to review any additional redactions?

Thanks Diego — reviewed.

Plan: I'll produce a redacted runbook PDF that covers:
- Pipeline auth and token exchange (diagram + brief sequence)
- Ephemeral runner lifecycle and SA scoping (short paragraph)
- Merge-gate checks (PR reviewers, automated policy, CI gating)
- Rollback/fast-revert guidance

Attachments included: redwood_ci_runbook_v2.pdf (redacted excerpt) and code_review_sampling_2026-04.csv (PR-level metadata only). Change-management-timeline.xlsx contains an anonymized example showing approvals and artifact hashes (no customer data).

Legal: nothing sensitive in the examples; redactions applied to commit IDs and job logs. If AssessCorp needs a notarized attestation we can escalate.

A couple of optional artifacts we can add if requested: build-agent inventory (partial), ephemeral credential rotation logs (sample).

Jordan Blake
Principal Platform Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Alicia Park <alicia.park@assessor.example.com>
To: diego.fernandez@redwood.com
Cc: security@finservco.com
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Secure SDLC artifacts + CI runbook (FinServCo SIG)

Diego / team — received, and that looks good. A couple of quick follow ups:

- The assessor panel prefers a single ZIP upload to the drive folder you control (link or HS ticket is fine). Can you place the three files in a shared folder and send the link? Please ensure folder access is set to restricted link and add a viewer expiry of 30 days if possible.
- We will accept redactions as described; please include a short readme.txt that lists what was redacted and why.
- One ask from FinServCo: can you include the sampling logic (a 2–3 line description) for how PRs were selected for the CSV?

If you can post the Drive link by EOD Monday (May 11) that'll meet intake timing. Thanks for the quick turnaround — Alicia.

Alicia Park
Senior Assessor, AssessCorp
notes: Attachments are redacted artifacts prepared for SIG intake; internal stakeholders agreed to limit exposure and include a readme describing redactions.
